attempts.rationale: The regression test validates the reported formatting bug in formatBytes and formatSpeed by asserting correct 1024-based unit conversion with one decimal place below 100 units and no decimal places from 100 units upward. The test imports the actual repository format.ts utility via the typescript_module loader, calls the exported functions with the specified inputs, and checks that output matches the expected human-readable unit strings. This captures the exact issue: the original source renders literal template fragments like 'v.toFixed(...)' and '{units[i]}' instead of resolved values. The test is deterministic, offline, and will fail on the unmodified repository source due to the bug.
